content:
anya: Quick postmortem follow-up — summary and concrete handoff asks for the streaming/chat endpoint incident. I pulled the things we agreed on in the meeting. Need owners + dates so we can roll these into the next sprint. 

sanjay: I'll take reconnect/backoff policy + server-side circuit breaker changes. Plan: add exponential jitter + tighten idle detection. Aim to have a canary by end of week. :thumbsup:

maria: I'll own telemetry + alert tuning. Specifically: (1) add a 'partial-response' rate metric, (2) create an SLA breach composite alert, (3) add a dashboard row for prefix cache hit/miss. ETA Tue next week.

liam: I'll work on the client SDK heartbeat/resume changes and small client-side debounce to reduce duplicate reconnects. I'll also add integration tests for resumed sessions. Target: 5 business days.

kai: Support will update customer-facing status notes and add a short KB on what to do if clients see partial streams. I'll keep triage tickets closed-looped to owners.

ops-bot: Created ticket INC-43210 for server reconnect changes, INC-43211 for telemetry/alerts, INC-43212 for SDK changes. Reminder scheduled: weekly check-in every Monday 09:00 PT.

anya: Two small priorities I want explicit owners on: queue-depth alert (we saw a spike that correlated with partials) and prefix cache TTL tuning. Proposals?

sanjay: I'll own queue-depth alert tuning as part of the reconnect work. Proposal: alert when avg queue depth > 75% of configured batch capacity for 3m, and page after 5m sustained.

maria: I'll take prefix cache TTL tuning — I'll run a 48h sweep of hit/miss patterns and propose a TTL matrix by model/seq-length.

liam: For SDK changes, here's the minimal change I'll ship first (pseudo):

```js
// client resumed-session debounce
if (resumeAttempt > 0 && now - lastResume < 2000) return;
resumeAttempt++;
// exponential backoff with jitter
await sleep(baseMs * 2 ** resumeAttempt * (0.8 + Math.random() * 0.4));
```

sanjay: Ops checklist for canary:
- deploy reconnect policy to 10% traffic
- enable additional logs: stream_id, reconnect_reason, server_idle_ms
- run synthetic chat session at 50qps for 30m
- watch partial-response rate and queue depth

aniya: small nit: let's make sure telemetry covers the client-side resume events too (liam + maria).

liam: noted, will emit resume_event metric in SDK v1.4.0.

anya: Recurring ownership: unless someone objects, we'll rotate the weekly 'streaming patrol' owner. Owner does quick checks on Monday + Friday and posts an ops snapshot. Suggested rotation: sanjay -> maria -> liam -> kai.

maria: Works for me. I'll pick next week's rotation notes template and post it under #incidents: 'patrol: queue | partial-rate | reconnects | recent deploys'.

sanjay: Quick debug snippet I used today to inspect pods (paste for runbook):

```bash
kubectl get pods -l app=redwood-streamer -o wide --sort-by=.status.containerStatuses[0].restartCount
kubectl logs -f $POD -c streamer --since=1h | grep partial_response || true
```

anya: Okay team — owners + targets recap: sanjay = reconnect & queue alert (canary by EOW), maria = telemetry + prefix TTL (proposal Tue), liam = SDK/resume (5 business days), kai = support KB & notices, ops-bot = tickets + weekly reminders. If no objections, I'll add these to the postmortem follow-up doc and assign PRs.

sanjay: No objections. :thumbsup:

maria: LGTM.

liam: good to go.

kai: I'll draft the KB and link to INC tickets.

anya: Thanks — please update the INC tickets with short check-in comments when you hit each milestone. We'll re-open this thread next Monday for the first patrol snapshot.
